title: mariscus pulcher
intro: Mariscus pulcher, commonly known as Sedges or Cattails, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The bioactive constituents of Mariscus pulcher include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
